bench_turret.item: Snail 2305 friction-wheel motor (+ C615 ESC)

alternates.changes: The shaft is a 5 mm (M5) prop shaft with a nut, on a 4 mm hollow steel inner shaft, instead of the Snail's 2.95 mm output shaft, so the flywheel hub must be redesigned (M5 bore or prop-adapter clamp). The mount is listed as 'Φ16mm' (iFlight 2306s use M3), so redraw the motor plate if the Snail plate differs. It is 33.8 g vs 27.8 g, stator 23 x 6 vs 23 x 5. Kv is 1700 vs the Snail's 875 rpm/V, about 2x faster, so on a 24 V (6S) bus cap throttle or rpm at about 50% in the ESC or firmware, or run it from a lower-voltage rail, then re-tune flywheel speed for ball exit velocity. It takes 2-6S at up to 36.66 A continuous and runs from the AM32 35 A ESC (no C615).
